head: Venmo can now scan a receipt and split the bill by item
dek: Venmo's new receipt scanning reads a photo of a bill, lists each item and lets you assign it to whoever ordered it. It adds everyone's share of tax and tip and sends the payment requests.
details: It works for everyone in the group whatever phone they use. It's rolling out now and will be widely available in the coming weeks. For costs you share over a longer time, such as rent or a trip, Venmo Groups keeps a running list.
where: Venmo app, US, rolling out now
means: After a group dinner or trip, one photo replaces the math of who owes what.
todo: In Venmo, tap the V to start a payment, choose Scan receipt, take or upload a photo, assign the items and send the requests.
thumb_words: SPLIT A BILL WITH ONE PHOTO
